rows.en: It had been a wonderful day at the beach.

ghs.en: Our beach outing was fun.

rows.jp: 今でも、皆のはしゃぎようは思い出せる。
rows.en: Even now, I can still remember everyone horsing around.

ghs.en: Even now I remember everybody's merrymaking.

rows.jp: 「きあああっ！？　どこつかんでんのよっ！？」
rows.en: “Eeeek! Where the hell are you grabbing me?!”

ghs.en: Touko: "KYAAAAH!? Where did you just grab meee?!"

rows.en: “The part of your swimsuit covering your ass.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "On the part of the swimsuit that covers your ass."

rows.jp: 「支倉さんって……黒須君とどういうご関係なんでしょうねぇ？」
rows.en: “Ms. Hasekura... just what kind of relationship might she have with Mr. Kurosu, I wonder?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Hasekura-san, you say... what is even your relationship with her, Kurosu-kun?"

rows.en: “Hm? You mean Youko?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hm? Youko-chan?"

rows.en: “YOUKO!?”

ghs.en:
Touko: "YOUKO-CHAN?!"
Misato: "YOUKO-CHAN!?!"
Miki: "YOUKO-CHAAAAN?"
Tomoki: "YOUKO-CHAN!!!"

rows.en: “At this point, you’re basically a gangster.”

ghs.en: Miki: "What a Yakuza, really."

rows.en: “N-not my booody!”

ghs.en: Misato: "My-, my body you caaa～n't!"

rows.jp: 「あのっ、失礼しますしますしますっ！！！！」
rows.en: “S-s-sorry to intrude-trude-trude!”

ghs.en: Yusa: "A-uhm, if I maying may may mayyyyyy!!!!!!"

rows.en: “Idiot.”

ghs.en: Touko: "Iii-diot."

rows.en: “It’s coming! It’s comi-womi?”

ghs.en: Yusa: "Ah, this way, this wayay?"

rows.en: “O-owww! My forehead hurts!”

ghs.en: Miki: "It-, it huuu～rts, forehead huuu～rts!"

rows.en: “...Mutter, mutter, mutter.”

ghs.en: Misato: "...(mutter, mutter, mutter)"

rows.en: “It was fun, though.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But we still had fun."

rows.jp: 楽しい海水浴はこれでおしまい。
rows.en: And with that, our beach outing was over.

ghs.en: Our fun beach outing has with this concluded.

rows.jp: 美希の傷は、ほんの少しだけ跡が残りそうだった。
rows.en: Miki’s wound looked likely to leave the faintest scar.

ghs.en: As for Miki's cut, it only left behind a very small scar.

rows.jp: それでも帰り道、本人は晴れ晴れとした顔をしていた。
rows.en: Even so, she looked positively radiant on the way home.

ghs.en: Nevertheless, on the way back, said Miki had the most bright and cheerful face on her,

rows.jp: 傷ついたかわりに、何かを得たような。
rows.en: As though getting hurt had given her something in return.

ghs.en: as if she had obtained something in exchange for being hurt.

rows.en: That was the look on her face.

ghs.en: That's what her face said.

rows.jp: そのあと、見里先輩が放送部用のアンテナ搬入につきあうため、学校に戻って。
rows.en: Afterward, Mimi went back to school to help bring in the Broadcasting Club’s antenna.

ghs.en: After that, Misato-senpai had to help bring in the antenna for the Broadcast Club, and returned to school.

rows.jp: まだ姉とは断絶していなかった友貴が、皮肉を言って。
rows.en: Tomoki, not yet estranged from his sister, made a sarcastic remark.

ghs.en: Tomoki, not yet wholly torn apart from his sister, said something sarcastic.

rows.jp: そのシスコンぶりを、当時まだ群青付属三年生だった美希にからかわれて。
rows.en: Miki—then a third-year in Gunjo’s junior-high division—teased him for being so obsessed with his sister.

ghs.en: His sisconlike ways were then ridiculed by Miki, then still in the third year of the middle school subordinate to Gunjou.

rows.jp: 遊紗ちゃんが、集団というものに対してはじめて、小さく心を開いた。
rows.en: And for the first time, Yusa opened her heart—just a crack—to the idea of belonging to a group.

ghs.en: Yusa-chan opened her heart a little to the concept of group for the first time.

rows.en: That was the kind of day we’d had at the beach.

ghs.en: And that had been our beach outing.
